front.title: Shuliak Isolation Protocol (SIP-1): Stateless Format-Preserving Pseudonymization and AST Quarantine for Local AI Agent Transports

abstract.t: Autonomous AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers frequently execute over local standard input/output (stdio) pipes outside enterprise network inspection perimeters. Naive redaction of sensitive credentials with static placeholders invalidates downstream Luhn payment card and ISO-7064 IBAN schema validators, while raw payload forwarding exposes regulated data. This document specifies the Shuliak Isolation Protocol (SIP-1), a deterministic, zero-egress security layer combining stateless Format-Preserving Encryption (FF1), Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) JSON-RPC payload quarantine, and detached cryptographic schema locks.
